منصة اعتماد — Saudi Government Tenders

📋 Etimad Tenders

An Odoo 19 backend module that automatically fetches Saudi government tenders from tenders.etimad.sa and stores them in Odoo — ready to convert into CRM opportunities with one click.

✅ Odoo 19 Compatible 🇸🇦 Saudi Etimad API 🤖 Auto-fetch via Cron CRM Integration

Key Features

⚡
Auto Fetch (Cron)

Scheduled daily job pulls the latest tenders automatically. Configurable page count per run.

🔍
Manual Fetch Wizard

Run on demand with keyword / agency filters. Instantly see how many records were created vs. updated.

🎯
CRM Conversion

One-click conversion turns any tender into a CRM Opportunity with agency, value and deadline pre-filled.

🛡️
Bot Protection Bypass

Smart session warm-up collects F5 TrafficShield anti-bot cookies so API calls always succeed.

⚙️
Configurable Settings

Set page size, cron pages, custom API URL, and optional session cookie — all from the module settings screen.

🔄
Duplicate-safe Upsert

Existing tenders are updated in-place; only new records are created. Unique constraint on Etimad tender ID.

How It Works

  1. 1
    Session warm-up — A GET to the Etimad listing page loads F5 TrafficShield cookies, defeating bot protection.
  2. 2
    API call — GET /Tender/AllSupplierTendersForVisitorAsync returns paginated JSON with tender metadata.
  3. 3
    Upsert — Each tender is matched by its Etimad ID; existing records are updated, new ones are created.
  4. 4
    CRM conversion — Click "Create Opportunity" on any tender to push it straight into the CRM pipeline.
  5. 5
    Cron — A daily scheduled action repeats steps 1-3 automatically. Configure pages-per-run in Settings.

Installation

# 1. Copy module to your addons path
cp -r etimad_tenders /home/odoo/src/user/

# 2. Push to Odoo.sh
git add etimad_tenders && git commit -m "Add Etimad Tenders"
odoosh-push

# 3. Install in Odoo
Apps → search "Etimad" → Install
Dependencies
crm mail requests Odoo 19

Technical Notes

🔌 Confirmed API Endpoint
GET /Tender/AllSupplierTendersForVisitorAsync

Returns paginated JSON with full tender details. Parameters: PageNumber, PageSize (max 100). No authentication required for public tenders.

🍪 F5 TrafficShield

The Etimad platform uses F5 BIG-IP bot protection (TS* cookies). The module performs a warm-up GET to the HTML listing page first, which sets the required cookies. Subsequent API calls reuse the session with those cookies — no CAPTCHA solving needed.

📦 Odoo 19 Patterns
  • models.Constraint (replaces _sql_constraints)
  • <app>/<block>/<setting> settings pattern
  • No numbercall in ir.cron
  • page_count in pager dict (not pages)
🗂️ Data Model
  • Model: etimad.tender
  • Key fields: tender ID, name, agency, type, value, dates
  • States: new → open → closed / cancelled / converted
  • Linked to crm.lead via Many2one
